This is a lesson on one comping rhythm the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and**. It is built up from 2 simpler patterns, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Comping rhythms](index.qmd#chords)

## The pattern

Thumb and fingers, after John Prine. The thumb plays every beat on the low strings: the root, an inner string, the alternate bass, the inner string again. The fingers pinch a treble string with the thumb on 2 and 4 and add the string below it on the and after. In 3/4 the pinches are on 2 and 3.

It belongs in *John Prine Fingerpicking*, *Boom-chick*, *Acoustic strum*, *Folk carol* and *Country train beat*. Here it is in the john prine fingerpicking style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Strum: downstrokes on the beat

Start with something simpler. One ringing downstroke on every beat. The first strum to learn, and the usual one for a slow song.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-strum-quarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="prine" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="70" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Strum: downstrokes on the beat","opts":{"compRhythm":"strumQuarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Boom-chick / oom-pah-pah

Short chords on the beats the bass leaves free: 2 and 4 in 4/4, 2 and 3 in a waltz. Goes with the Root and fifth bass line.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-oompah.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="prine" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="70" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Boom-chick / oom-pah-pah","opts":{"compRhythm":"oompah"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The thumb plays every beat: root, an inner string, the alternate bass, the inner string. On 2 and 4 a finger pinches a treble string together with the thumb, and on the and after it plays the string below. Get the thumb going alone first; it must not stop when the fingers join.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="prine" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="70" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and","opts":{"compRhythm":"prine"}},{"label":"Boom-chick / oom-pah-pah (the step before)","opts":{"compRhythm":"oompah"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 100 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's chord player off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="prine" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="100" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and","opts":{"compRhythm":"prine"}}]'></div>

## Step 5: Two chords in a bar

Harder: now some bars have two chords, two beats each. The pattern keeps its rhythm and changes chord where the bar does: watch the staff for the hit that lands on beat 3.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="prine" data-chart="G C|D G|C D|G" data-tempo="100" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and","opts":{"compRhythm":"prine"}}]'></div>

## Step 6: In 3/4

The same pattern in a waltz: three beats to the bar. Listen for what it keeps and what it drops when the bar is a beat shorter.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="waltz" data-chart="C|C|F|F|G7|G7|C|C" data-tempo="120" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp" data-meter="3/4" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and","opts":{"compRhythm":"prine"}}]'></div>
